items.rss_summary: Финляндия присоединяется к инициативе Франции по усилению ядерного сдерживания, сообщил глава Минобороны Финляндии Антти Хяккянен. В марте президент Франции Макрон объявил о введении в действие доктрины "продвинутого ядерного сдерживания". items.original_title: Japan’s Chubu Electric bosses resign over quake data-tampering scandal
items.rss_summary:
Two top executives at Japanese nuclear plant operator Chubu Electric Power would step down following a quake data-tampering scandal, the company said in a statement on Monday.
President Kingo Hayashi and Chairman Satoru Katsuno would be replaced, the statement said, and the firm would withdraw applications to restart the Nos 3 and 4 reactors at Chubu’s Hamaoka nuclear plant.
Japan is moving to revive nuclear power 15 years after an enormous earthquake and tsunami sent reactors at the Fukushima..

The Himalayas are approaching a tipping point as glaciers melt faster than a decade ago, threatening water security as the region approaches “peak water” by mid-century, according to a study released this month.
The findings come after the collapse of a Himalayan glacier in late August along the ‌Nepal-Tibet border, which caused cascading landslides and flash floods in the valleys below. At least 1,300 people have been confirmed dead and more than 5,300 are missing across Nepal and China’s Tibet
